THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/570 dated 25.10.2023 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Pesalai in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/56 of Pesalai South in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow.
01. Lot 'A' – Pesalaikaani – Extent: 2.8900 Hectare North, East, South and West: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known).
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/107.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.14th February, 2024.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN /MNN/2023/480 dated 27.10.2023 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Tullukudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/54 of Thullukudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow.

01. Lot 'A' – Thullukudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 0.9307 Hectare North and East: Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); South: Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) and Lot B; West: Lot B and Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known).

02. Lot 'B' – Thullukudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 1.9593 Hectare North: Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) and Lot A; East: Lot A and Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); South and West: Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known).
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/103.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.14th February, 2024.
